name: gcp
description: GCP topology connector — discovers Compute Engine instances, Cloud Run services, and GKE clusters + nodepools via the Google Cloud SDK. Auth via Application Default Credentials.

versions.changelog: Fix: the declared SDK versions (@google-cloud/compute ^4.13.0, @google-cloud/run ^1.6.0) were never published, so installing the connector's dependencies failed; now compute ^7.9.0, run ^4.2.0, container ^7.3.0 with a committed lockfile. Compute Engine discovery used InstancesClient.aggregatedList(), which the SDK doesn't have — it now iterates aggregatedListAsync(). The new SDK majors require Node.js >=22 (the server image ships Node 26).

Initial release: GCE + Cloud Run + GKE topology discovery. OWNED_BY edges link GKE nodepools to clusters. 30s snapshot TTL. Lazy SDK load — connector boots cleanly even when @google-cloud/* not installed (loader smoke contract).
